fields.title: Shōnin Kyōjutsu Sho (Witness Statement on Sanitary Compliance)

statement_subject.event: Utari binti Arsad no dentō ichiba ni okeru eisei kaizen sagyō

fields.statement: Watashi wa shinseisha Utari binti Arsad ga shoki karantina meirei igo, ichiba nai no sōji, shōdoku, oyobi eisei kankyō no tettei teki na kaizen o jisshi shita koto o mokugeki shita.

claims.fact: Shōnin no kyōjutsu wa ichiba no eisei jōtai ga kaizen sareta koto o zisshō suru.
